author: KEXP
description: The smooth, soulful stylings of singer-songwriter Samm Henshaw find their way to the KEXP Live Room in our latest in-studio session. With buttery vocals and slow-burn grooves off his latest release 'It Could Be Worse,' Henshaw shares a performance of "Float" and more.
title: Samm Henshaw performs "Hair Down" & more Live on KEXP

author: KEXP
